bull_case: 광고 AI 성과가 이미 클릭·전환과 광고단가 개선으로 나타나고 있어 2026년의 초대형 R&D·인프라 투자가 향후 높은 증분 수익으로 전환될 수 있다. 현금창출 기반과 다수의 재투자 경로는 매우 크다.
bear_case: TTM 기준 capex+R&D가 OCF를 약 126% 흡수하고 Q2 FCF는 거의 0까지 떨어졌다. AI 인프라의 유지성 지출 비중과 증분 ROIC가 불명확해 과거의 자산경량형 고ROIC 구조가 자본집약형으로 바뀔 위험이 있다.
thesis: 재투자 활주로 자체는 매우 크지만 수익률 검증이 뒤따르지 못했다. TTM capex 약 $92.4B와 R&D 약 $71.6B를 TTM OCF 약 $130.3B로 나누면 내부 재투자 흡수율은 약 126%다. 그러나 60%+ 구간의 90점은 증분 ROIC가 자본비용의 2배 이상이라는 추가 조건이 필요한데 아직 입증되지 않아 직전 80점 상한을 적용한다. incremental ROIC와 FCF/share quality는 모두 50으로 제한한다.

evidence.claim: Estimated TTM OCF through Q2 2026 is ~$130.3B; TTM capex including finance-lease principal is ~$92.4B and TTM R&D is ~$71.6B, implying (capex+R&D)/OCF of about 126%.
FY2025 FCF was $43.585B versus $52.103B in 2024; Q2 2026 company-defined FCF was only $0.784B after $31.08B of capex.

AI ranking changes produced measured +3.5% Facebook clicks, >1% Instagram conversions and +3% conversions from another runtime model, evidence that at least part of AI reinvestment is producing economic output.
H1 2026 diluted weighted-average shares were 2.565B versus 2.580B in H1 2025, so SBC has not translated into current net share-count growth.

counterevidence: 2026 capex guidance of $130B-$145B implies cash conversion may remain depressed.
Maintenance-like versus growth capex is not separately disclosed.
Reality Labs consumes roughly $20B annual operating profit without demonstrated financial return.
The recent ad-performance gains do not yet establish a company-wide incremental ROIC above 2x cost of capital.
unknowns: A decision-useful split between maintenance and growth AI capex is not disclosed.
Incremental NOPAT attributable specifically to 2025-26 AI infrastructure is not separately reported.
falsifiers: FCF remains below $30B through 2028 despite double-digit revenue growth.
AI-driven ad conversion gains fade while capex remains above $100B annually.
Owner FCF/share fails to recover even as net share count stays flat/down.

hard_veto_flags.rationale: H1 diluted share count declined YoY, so persistent excessive net dilution and per-share-value destruction are not established.
Incremental ROIC is uncertain, but revenue, ad pricing and measured AI conversion outcomes are improving; neither below-cost incremental ROIC nor its structural persistence is established.

key_kpis.name: TTM capex+R&D / OCF
key_kpis.direction: decline after buildout while growth persists

next_checks: Bridge AI capex to incremental revenue/operating profit as disclosures improve.
Track FCF/share rather than aggregate FCF alone.

subscores.rationale: The 50 'measurement uncertain' anchor is appropriate: product-level AI returns are positive, but the incremental return on the full infrastructure/R&D capital base cannot be isolated. 75 is excluded because company-wide incremental ROIC is not yet verified.

TTM (capex+R&D)/OCF is ~126%, well above 60%, showing exceptional absorption capacity. The 90 row additionally requires incremental ROIC >=2x cost of capital; that condition is not established, so the preceding observable score of 80 is used rather than fabricating the missing return test.

Reported FCF fell in 2025 and Q2 2026 FCF was nearly exhausted by capex. Net shares are contained, but normalized post-buildout FCF/share is still an estimate; this matches the 50 'distortion large' anchor and excludes 75.

uncertainties.rationale: The economic return on the unprecedented AI infrastructure step-up is the central unresolved variable.
Current FCF/share is depressed by a capex cycle whose normalized endpoint is unknown.

dilution_metrics.rationale: Net diluted share count declined YoY despite large SBC; no persistent net-dilution pattern is established.
